title: Ice sheet expansion may have started 2,000 years ago, but we canceled that
summary: It is the last surviving fragment of the Laurentide Ice Sheet, the largest of the Pleistocene ice sheets, which at its peak buried most of Canada under two miles of ice and locked away around 80 meters of sea level.
